## WF-Strategist — Strategist pass (fb-run-strategist + daily auto-run)
TWO triggers. (1) The Dashboard 'Run Strategist' button (executive-gated) POSTs { scheduled_date } with the `x-webhook-secret: __N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET__` header — explicit intent, may re-draft an existing brief. (2) Daily 7:00 AM ET schedule: targets the earliest upcoming planned slot with no brief (plan_date >= today+2; fallback today+3) and NEVER overwrites a draft/approved brief (Build returns [] and the run ends).

Strategist decides WHAT to post and WHY, then emits ONE Content Brief — it does NOT write the post. Build Strategist Request reads dashboard data signals from the LP Supabase (source/market scorecards vs goals, content engagement via v_fb_post_engagement fed by WF5, rejection reasons, recently-used plan+subtopics, message bank) + the active `strategist` prompt, all via this.helpers.httpRequest (scorecard reads degrade gracefully if the LP-MCP tables are absent). Anthropic returns the 12-field brief JSON; Parse Brief upserts it onto the target date's fb_content_plan slot (on_conflict=plan_date, merge-duplicates) with brief_status='draft'. A human approves the brief on the calendar (PlanReview → Approve brief) before WF1/WF-Batch consume it.

Replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `__...__` placeholders on import. Keep `active:false` in the committed copy.
